source_evidence: Risk tolerance is your ability and willingness to lose some or all of your original investment in exchange for potentially greater returns.
answer: Risk tolerance describes both your ability and willingness to accept the possibility of losing some or all of your original investment in pursuit of potentially greater returns. An investor with higher risk tolerance is willing to risk losses for the possibility of higher returns; an investor with lower risk tolerance favors investments that seek to maintain the original investment. Because risk tolerance helps shape asset allocation, the allocation that suits an investor can vary with their circumstances and may change over time.
